name: feastogether-intranet
description: 饗賓內部電子簽署系統

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,worker,client -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter feastogether-intranet-server dev" "pnpm --filter feastogether-intranet-server worker:dev" "pnpm --filter feastogether-intranet-client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter feastogether-intranet-server build && pnpm --filter feastogether-intranet-client build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter feastogether-intranet-server lint:check && pnpm --filter feastogether-intranet-client lint
